frank: Quick summary from today's cedar-6b-int4 bring-up against GTN. Link to artifacts: https://s3.redwood-inference/internal/cedar6b/2026-03-22/report.json. Headline: ~50% token compute savings vs int6, median latency 105ms -> 70ms, p95 480ms -> 340ms. Overall QA EM fell 0.918 -> 0.896 (2.2 pt drop). Long-context (>2k tokens) shows ~5.8 pt regression and duplicated facts on extraction tasks. Need concise plan for canary + fallback + experiments.

ivy: thanks. per-intent quicks: search +0.3, single-doc-summarize -1.1, multi-doc-summarize -4.6, extraction -3.2, code +0.0. Looks concentrated on multi-doc summarization and extraction with long KV chains.

liam: ops recs: start a 5% canary with full shadowing to cedar-6b-int6. Also enable a length-based fallback: if incoming context >1200 tokens route to int6. Keep sticky KV routing so warmed sessions stay consistent. Example feature flag (for infra):

FLAG: routing.length_hybrid = true; threshold = 1200; canary_pct = 5; fallback = "cedar-6b-int6"

ivy: on the quant side I propose two parallel experiments: (1) per-layer outlier-clipping + 8-bit compensation (small cost +7%), (2) mixed-precision keep first/last 2 layers at int6 (cost +10%). Run both as shadows during the canary and compare EM and hallucination_rate per slice.

frank: product ask: minimize user-visible regressions. Can we also add a saliency precheck to route cases with many citations or named entities to int6? That should catch multi-doc summaries without routing all long contexts.

liam: we can implement a cheap saliency probe: count named-entities and citation-like tokens in the prefix, threshold=6 entities or >100 citation-tokens -> route to int6. Low overhead.

ops-bot: Canary launched: cedar-6b-int4 @ 5% traffic. Shadowing to cedar-6b-int6 enabled. Shadows attached: experiment-A(outlier-clip+8b-comp), experiment-B(mixed-precision). Monitors: gtn_em, hallucination_rate, latency_p95, token_entropy. Alerts: em_delta >= 1.0pt on critical slices, hallucination_delta >= 0.5% absolute.

ivy: please add three redacted failing prompts to the ticket: (1) "Aggregate action items across 4 documents and produce timeline" (~3.1k tokens) -> inserted dates; (2) "Extract citations and map to paragraph" (~3.4k tokens) -> duplicated refs; (3) "Compile meeting thread into ordered decisions" (~2.7k tokens) -> merged unrelated decisions.

frank: timeline: run 24h canary then evaluate. If experiments show mixed-precision recovers >80% of EM gap with cost delta <12% we recommend promoting to 30% and re-evaluating after 72h. Product ok with initial 5% canary.

product-bot: Product acked: 5% canary approved. Prepare rollback playbook and notify GTN support.

liam: one more measurable: run a 2k-sample priming entropy probe comparing token-level entropy between int4 and int6; if entropy drift >0.5 nats on multi-doc slices, prioritize experiment-A.

frank: good. I'll attach the snapshot and failing examples to infra/eng-ml#1422 and assign to @ivy and @liam. Keep slack thread short; updates go in ticket.

(emoji: :thumbsup: on ops-bot message, :eyes: on ivy replies)
